g.text: Visual guide to UTF-8 bit architecture, Base64 3-to-4 transformation math, Hexadecimal bytes, and HTML entities.
THE BASE64 24-BIT CONVERSION PIPELINE (3 BYTES → 4 CHARACTERS)
Latin accented, Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew & Arabic
Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP): Chinese, Japanese, Devnagari
Supplementary planes: Emojis, ancient scripts, math symbols
Continuation byte rule: Every subsequent byte begins with 10xxxxxx.
• Big-Endian (BE): MSB first (Standard for network protocols)
• Little-Endian (LE): LSB first (x86, ARM64 hardware native)
